Mille-feuille à la vanille de Tahiti uses Tahitian vanilla - more floral and complex than Madagascar. This is a refined French menu in its original French terminology.

quests.hint: Langouste is spiny lobster - different from homard (clawed lobster) - common in Mediterranean cuisine.
quests.explanation: Langouste (spiny lobster or rock lobster) lacks the large claws of homard (clawed lobster) but has sweet, firm tail meat. En croûte dorée means enclosed in golden pastry. Pigeonneau is young pigeon - cooked with its abats (offal: liver, heart, gizzard). Vacherin glacé is a frozen dessert of meringue and ice cream.
